OrbitDesk plans

This is a fictional product page for a local scraping demonstration. Starter costs MYR 20 per user per month, while Team costs MYR 35 per user per month. These prices exclude taxes. Support is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 Malaysia time. Customers can cancel renewal in Settings, Billing, Cancel renewal; access continues through the paid period.
